Card Q&A.a: The effect has already been activated, so the DP boost persists for the turn.
q: After I use this card’s [When Digivolving] effect to gain +2000 DP for each card with [Armor Form] in its traits in my trash, I use
to trash this card. What happens to the DP boost?

Effect: ＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
[When Digivolving] Unsuspend this Digimon, and it gets +2000 DP until the end of your opponent's next turn for each card with [Armor Form] in its traits in your trash.
